# Aim

This analysis generates heatmaps of MOFA2 factor scores across samples and annotates samples by clinical, pathology, modality-availability, and genomic-burden features.

The goal is to visualize whether the biologically relevant factors identified from prior analyses correspond to:

- histologic grade
- ER / PR / HER2 status
- HR/HER2 subtype
- TILs
- tumor cellularity
- mutation burden
- CNV burden
- omics modality availability

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Parameters

```{r parameters}
FOCUSED_FACTORS <- c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor4", "Factor5", "Factor6", "Factor9")

# Whether to cluster columns
CLUSTER_COLUMNS_FULL <- TRUE
CLUSTER_COLUMNS_FOCUSED <- FALSE

# If FALSE for focused heatmap, samples will be ordered by clinical/biological logic
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)$", "", x)

  x <- gsub("(?i)_T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)_N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x <- gsub("(?i)NL$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x
}

clean_grade <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(y))
  out[grepl("Grade II", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade II"
  out[grepl("Grade III", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade III"
  out[grepl("not determined", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Not determined"
  out
}

row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  t(scale(t(mat)))
}

check_pheatmap <- function() {
  if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Package 'pheatmap' is not installed. ",
      "Please install/load pheatmap in your R environment before running this script."
    )
  }
}

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

# Load merged factor/clinical/burden data

```{r load-data}
check_pheatmap()
library(pheatmap)

if (!file.exists(MERGED_BURDEN_FILE)) {
  stop("Merged burden file not found: ", MERGED_BURDEN_FILE)
}

merged_dt <- fread(MERGED_BURDEN_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
presence_dt <- fread(PRESENCE_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

merged_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]
presence_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]

if ("sample" %in% colnames(merged_dt)) {
  setnames(merged_dt, "sample", "Sample")
}

if ("Grade" %in% colnames(merged_dt)) {
  merged_dt[, Grade_clean := clean_grade(Grade)]
} else if (!"Grade_clean" %in% colnames(merged_dt)) {
  merged_dt[, Grade_clean := NA_character_]
}

factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(merged_dt), value = TRUE)

cat("Merged table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(merged_dt))

cat("Factor columns:\n")
print(factor_cols)

cat("Presence table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(presence_dt))

print(head(merged_dt))
```

# Merge modality availability

```{r merge-presence}
presence_keep <- copy(presence_dt)

merged_dt <- merge(
  merged_dt,
  presence_keep,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE,
  suffixes = c("", "_presence")
)

fwrite(
  merged_dt,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_factor_heatmap_input_merged_table.csv")
)

cat("Merged heatmap input dimensions:\n")
print(dim(merged_dt))
```

# Choose and prepare sample annotations

```{r prepare-annotations}
annotation_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "Grade",
    "HR_HER2_subtype",
    "TILs",
    "Tumor_cellularity",
    "WES_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "Combined_WES_IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden",
    "WES_CNV_gain_burden",
    "WES_CNV_loss_burden",
    "WES_CNV_absolute_burden",
    "RNA_log2TPM_top5000var",
    "WES_mutation_recurrent",
    "WES_CNV_numeric",
    "IMPACT_mutation_recurrent",
    "N_views_present"
  ),
  colnames(merged_dt)
)

annotation_dt <- merged_dt[, c("Sample", annotation_cols), with = FALSE]

# Convert logical modality columns to Yes/No for annotation display
logical_like_cols <- c(
  "RNA_log2TPM_top5000var",
  "WES_mutation_recurrent",
  "WES_CNV_numeric",
  "IMPACT_mutation_recurrent"
)

for (cc in intersect(logical_like_cols, colnames(annotation_dt))) {
  annotation_dt[, (cc) := fifelse(
    get(cc) %in% c(TRUE, 1),
    "Yes",
    fifelse(get(cc) %in% c(FALSE, 0), "No", NA_character_)
  )]
}

# Make categorical annotations explicit factors for ordering
factor_cols_for_ann <- intersect(
  c("Grade_clean", "ER_status", "PR_status", "HER2_status", "HR_status", "HR_HER2_subtype"),
  colnames(annotation_dt)
)

for (cc in factor_cols_for_ann) {
  annotation_dt[, (cc) := as.factor(get(cc))]
}

fwrite(
  annotation_dt,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_sample_annotations_for_heatmap.csv")
)

print(head(annotation_dt))
```

# Prepare factor matrix

```{r prepare-factor-matrix}
factor_dt <- merged_dt[, c("Sample", factor_cols), with = FALSE]

factor_mat <- as.matrix(factor_dt[, ..factor_cols])
rownames(factor_mat) <- factor_dt$Sample
storage.mode(factor_mat) <- "numeric"

# Heatmap wants features x samples, so transpose
factor_mat_t <- t(factor_mat)

# Z-score each factor across samples for comparable visualization
factor_mat_z <- row_zscore(factor_mat_t)

# Replace any all-NA or constant-factor rows after scaling
factor_mat_z[is.na(factor_mat_z)] <- 0

fwrite(
  as.data.table(factor_mat_z, keep.rownames = "Factor"),
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_factor_score_matrix_zscore_for_heatmap.csv")
)

cat("Factor matrix dimensions (factors x samples):\n")
print(dim(factor_mat_z))
```

# Define biologically ordered sample order

```{r sample-order}
ord_dt <- copy(merged_dt)

# Make helpful ordering variables
if ("Grade_clean" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, Grade_order := fifelse(
    Grade_clean == "Grade II", 1L,
    fifelse(Grade_clean == "Grade III", 2L,
            fifelse(Grade_clean == "Not determined", 3L, 4L))
  )]
} else {
  ord_dt[, Grade_order := 99L]
}

if ("HER2_status" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, HER2_order := fifelse(HER2_status == "Positive", 1L,
                                 fifelse(HER2_status == "Negative", 2L, 3L))]
} else {
  ord_dt[, HER2_order := 99L]
}

if ("ER_status" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, ER_order := fifelse(ER_status == "Positive", 1L,
                               fifelse(ER_status == "Negative", 2L, 3L))]
} else {
  ord_dt[, ER_order := 99L]
}

# Use Factor5 descending and Factor6 ascending to help highlight grade-related patterns
if ("Factor5" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, Factor5_order := -Factor5]
} else {
  ord_dt[, Factor5_order := 0]
}

if ("Factor6" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, Factor6_order := Factor6]
} else {
  ord_dt[, Factor6_order := 0]
}

if ("Factor4" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) {
  ord_dt[, Factor4_order := -Factor4]
} else {
  ord_dt[, Factor4_order := 0]
}

sample_order_biologic <- ord_dt[
  order(
    Grade_order,
    HER2_order,
    ER_order,
    Factor5_order,
    Factor6_order,
    Factor4_order,
    Sample
  ),
  Sample
]

sample_order_table <- ord_dt[
  match(sample_order_biologic, Sample),
  .(
    Sample,
    Grade_clean,
    ER_status,
    PR_status,
    HER2_status,
    HR_status,
    HR_HER2_subtype,
    TILs,
    Tumor_cellularity,
    Factor4 = if ("Factor4" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) Factor4 else NA_real_,
    Factor5 = if ("Factor5" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) Factor5 else NA_real_,
    Factor6 = if ("Factor6" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) Factor6 else NA_real_,
    WES_mutation_burden_allgenes = if ("WES_mutation_burden_allgenes" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) WES_mutation_burden_allgenes else NA_real_,
    WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden = if ("WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden" %in% colnames(ord_dt)) WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden else NA_real_
  )
]

fwrite(
  sample_order_table,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_biologic_sample_order_for_heatmap.csv")
)

print(sample_order_table)
```

# Prepare annotation data frame for pheatmap

```{r pheatmap-annotations}
annotation_df <- as.data.frame(annotation_dt)
rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$Sample
annotation_df$Sample <- NULL

# Match annotation order to biologic sample order
annotation_df <- annotation_df[sample_order_biologic, , drop = FALSE]

# Keep only samples present in factor matrix
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(factor_mat_z), rownames(annotation_df))

factor_mat_z_ordered <- factor_mat_z[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
annotation_df <- annotation_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Focused factor matrix
focused_factors <- intersect(FOCUSED_FACTORS, rownames(factor_mat_z_ordered))
factor_mat_z_focused <- factor_mat_z_ordered[focused_factors, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Samples in heatmap:", length(common_samples), "\n")
cat("Focused factors:\n")
print(focused_factors)

writeLines(
  common_samples,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_heatmap_sample_order.txt")
)
```

# Correlation of factors with continuous annotations

```{r factor-continuous-summary}
continuous_ann <- intersect(
  c(
    "TILs",
    "Tumor_cellularity",
    "WES_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "Combined_WES_IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes",
    "WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden",
    "WES_CNV_absolute_burden"
  ),
  colnames(annotation_df)
)

factor_continuous_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(rownames(factor_mat_z_ordered), function(fac) {
  rbindlist(lapply(continuous_ann, function(cc) {
    x <- as.numeric(factor_mat_z_ordered[fac, ])
    y <- safe_numeric(annotation_df[[cc]])

    ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

    if (sum(ok) < 5) {
      return(data.table(
        Factor = fac,
        Annotation = cc,
        Spearman_rho = NA_real_,
        P_value = NA_real_,
        N = sum(ok)
      ))
    }

    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))

    data.table(
      Factor = fac,
      Annotation = cc,
      Spearman_rho = unname(ct$estimate),
      P_value = ct$p.value,
      N = sum(ok)
    )
  }))
}), fill = TRUE)

factor_continuous_summary[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  factor_continuous_summary[order(P_value)],
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_factor_continuous_annotation_correlation_summary.csv")
)

print(factor_continuous_summary[order(P_value)])
```

# Simple annotation completeness summary

```{r annotation-summary}
annotation_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(colnames(annotation_df), function(cc) {
  x <- annotation_df[[cc]]

  data.table(
    Annotation = cc,
    N_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(x) & x != ""),
    N_missing = sum(is.na(x) | x == ""),
    Percent_nonmissing = round(100 * mean(!is.na(x) & x != ""), 2)
  )
}))

fwrite(
  annotation_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_heatmap_annotation_completeness_summary.csv")
)

print(annotation_summary)
```
